panels.title: ${project}
panels.description: Only the selected production project. CPU is a share of total host capacity; RAM is combined container working set. Resource presence does not prove application readiness.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name!="",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"${project:regex}"}[5m]))) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.description: Per-container working-set memory and its configured finite cap. No limit line is drawn when the cap is missing or effectively unlimited.

panels.title: CPU / ${container:text}
panels.description: CPU / host is usage divided by host capacity. Throttled is the percentage of scheduling periods in which this container hit its CPU quota; it is not lost CPU time or host steal. Both use five-minute rates.

targets.expr: 100 * max by(name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor",image!="",name=~"${container:regex}",container_label_com_docker_compose_project=~"${project:regex}"}[5m])) / scalar(count(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node",mode="idle"})) and on() (min(up{job="cadvisor"}) == 1) and on() (min(up{job="node"}) == 1)

panels.title: Container health
panels.description: Observed starts include automatic restarts and detected recreations; short-lived manual restarts between polls may be missed. No check means no Docker healthcheck, not proven readiness. OOM is Docker's current OOMKilled state; kernel OOM events are on Server. Only containers with a restart policy are included.

options.content:
{{#each data}}

{{shortName name}}

Process
{{runningText running}}
Health
{{healthText healthy}}
Starts 24h
{{count starts}}
OOM killed
{{oomText oom}}
{{/each}}
options.helpers: context.handlebars.registerHelper('shortName', value => String(value || 'Unknown').replace(/^.+-prod[-_]/, '')); context.handlebars.registerHelper('runningText', value => value === 1 ? 'Running' : value === 0 ? 'Stopped' : 'Unknown'); context.handlebars.registerHelper('healthText', value => value === 1 ? 'Healthy' : value === 0 ? 'Not healthy' : 'No check'); context.handlebars.registerHelper('oomText', value => value === 1 ? 'Yes' : value === 0 ? 'No' : 'Unknown'); context.handlebars.registerHelper('count', value => typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? Math.round(value) : 'Unknown');
